## Household and background

Sage Whitaker (born April 11, 1962 — 63) is single with no dependents and lives at 512 Alder Street in Anytown. Since scaling back to part-time circulation work at the Anytown Public Library she has been living partly off her traditional IRA: one W-2 (box 1 wages $23,140.00, box 2 withholding $4,760.00) and one 1099-R from Harbor Federal Savings for the year's IRA withdrawals — $28,460.00, box 7 code 7 with the IRA/SEP/SIMPLE box checked.
